variables.name: DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT
variables.consumer: Advanced I/O and retry Job environment gates and durable rows
variables.development: required in both function targets

variables.name: X_ZOHO_CATALYST_ENVIRONMENT
variables.consumer: Catalyst Function Job pre-SDK environment boundary
variables.development: injected by Catalyst; independently read back before enabling the schedule
variables.production: Production or missing value rejected before SDK initialization

variables.name: ZOHO_CATALYST_ZCQL_PARSER
variables.consumer: Advanced I/O and retry Job Catalyst configuration gates
variables.development: required in both targets for reviewed conditional ZCQL statements

variables.name: SOURCE_REVISION
variables.consumer: Advanced I/O and retry Job durable audit rows
variables.development: same reviewed immutable source revision in both targets

variables.name: RETELL_WEBHOOK_API_KEY
variables.consumer: raw-body Retell signature verifier
variables.development: Development Retell workspace only
variables.production: separate provisioning required and rejected here

variables.name: RETELL_SHARED_AGENT_ID
variables.consumer: Advanced I/O resolver/event gate and retry Job ownership gate
variables.development: exact shared Development agent in both targets

variables.name: RETELL_SHARED_AGENT_VERSION
variables.consumer: Advanced I/O resolver/event gate and retry Job ownership gate
variables.development: same pinned Development version in both targets

variables.name: RETELL_INBOUND_PATH
variables.consumer: Advanced I/O router
variables.development: exact route

variables.name: RETELL_EVENTS_PATH
variables.consumer: Advanced I/O router
variables.development: exact route

variables.name: INTERNAL_READINESS_PATH
variables.consumer: Advanced I/O private readiness route
variables.development: exact route

variables.name: FREE_TEST_DEVELOPMENT_HOST
variables.consumer: pre-SDK Development environment boundary
variables.format: exact private Advanced I/O host using the documented .development.catalystserverless.<region> or .development.zohocatalyst.<region> family
variables.development: must match request Host exactly; value remains outside Git; avoids Catalyst's reserved CATALYST_ namespace

variables.name: FREE_TEST_DEVELOPMENT_PROJECT_ID
variables.consumer: Advanced I/O SDK identity and retry Job pre-SDK identity boundaries
variables.format: exact numeric private Catalyst Development project ID
variables.development: required in both targets; must match SDK app.config.projectId and jobRequest.getProjectDetails().id; value remains outside Git; avoids Catalyst's reserved CATALYST_ namespace
variables.production: mismatch rejected before Data Store or Mail access

variables.name: FREE_TEST_RETRY_JOB_POOL_ID
variables.consumer: Function Job pre-SDK job-pool identity boundary
variables.format: exact numeric private Development Function Job pool ID
variables.development: must match the platform Job Pool details ID; value remains outside Git

variables.name: RETELL_SIGNATURE_MAX_AGE_MS
variables.consumer: Retell signature verifier
variables.development: official five-minute window

variables.name: MAX_WEBHOOK_BYTES
variables.consumer: raw-body reader
variables.development: bounded request size

variables.name: INBOUND_BODY_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.consumer: raw-body reader
variables.development: per-request body deadline

variables.name: EVENT_HMAC_SECRET
variables.consumer: Advanced I/O and retry Job receipt, call, correlation, and notification keyed digests
variables.development: same stable value in both targets for retained rows
variables.production: separate key required and rejected here

variables.name: NUMBER_LOOKUP_HMAC_SECRET
variables.consumer: called-number lookup digest
variables.development: stable while bindings are active
variables.production: separate key required and rejected here

variables.name: INTERNAL_READINESS_TOKEN
variables.consumer: private readiness authentication
variables.development: Development operator secret
variables.production: separate key required and rejected here

variables.name: PLATFORM_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.consumer: Advanced I/O and retry Job Data Store/ZCQL adapters
variables.development: same per-operation ceiling in both targets

variables.name: FREE_TEST_NOTIFICATION_MODE
variables.consumer: Advanced I/O and retry Job Catalyst Mail adapters
variables.development: same value in both targets; dry_run is the committed default; send_development is limited to the controlled verified-sender and approved-synthetic-recipient test

variables.name: FREE_TEST_MAIL_FROM
variables.consumer: Advanced I/O and retry Job Catalyst Mail adapters
variables.format: verified sender email; value remains private and outside Git
variables.development: same verified Catalyst Development sender in both targets

variables.name: FREE_TEST_MAIL_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.consumer: Advanced I/O and retry Job Catalyst Mail adapters
variables.development: same provider invocation ceiling in both targets

variables.name: FREE_TEST_NOTIFICATION_MAX_ATTEMPTS
variables.consumer: Advanced I/O and retry Job notification state machine
variables.development: same bounded retry count in both targets

variables.name: DEPLOYMENT_TABLE
variables.consumer: Advanced I/O and retry Job Catalyst Data Store adapters
variables.development: reviewed new table in both targets

variables.name: EVENT_RECEIPT_TABLE
variables.consumer: Advanced I/O and retry Job Catalyst Data Store adapters
variables.development: reviewed new table in both targets; distinct from the preserved incompatible legacy RetellEventReceipts table

variables.name: CANONICAL_CALL_TABLE
variables.consumer: Advanced I/O and retry Job Catalyst Data Store adapters
variables.development: reviewed new table in both targets

variables.name: NOTIFICATION_TABLE
variables.consumer: Advanced I/O and retry Job Catalyst Data Store adapters
variables.development: reviewed new table in both targets
